mac-native.subtitle: Optimized for Apple Silicon
mac-native.description: A performance-focused modpack built specifically for macOS with Apple Silicon optimization. Enjoy Minecraft at its best on your Mac with native ARM performance.
mac-native.step1: Download and install the Modrinth App or Prism Launcher.
mac-native.step2: Search for "Mac Native" in the modpack browser or import the file.
mac-native.step3: Allocate at least 4 GB of RAM in the launcher settings.
mac-native.step4: Ensure you have Java 17+ (ARM build) installed.
mac-native.step5: Launch and enjoy optimized performance on your Mac!

crafttoons.subtitle: Cartoon-Styled Minecraft
crafttoons.description: Transform your Minecraft experience with vibrant cartoon aesthetics, custom shaders, and handpicked visual mods that make every block pop with personality.
crafttoons.step1: Download and install Prism Launcher or MultiMC.
crafttoons.step3: Allocate at least 6 GB of RAM for optimal shader performance.
crafttoons.step4: Enable the included shader pack from Video Settings > Shader Packs.
crafttoons.step5: Adjust shader quality based on your GPU capability.

astralrinth.subtitle: Explore the Cosmos
astralrinth.description: A space exploration modpack featuring custom dimensions, galactic biomes, and interstellar adventure. Build your rocket and explore the unknown universe.
astralrinth.step1: Download the modpack from the Mediafire link below.
astralrinth.step2: Install CurseForge App or Prism Launcher.
astralrinth.step3: Import the downloaded .zip file into your launcher.
astralrinth.step4: Allocate at least 8 GB of RAM for the best experience.
astralrinth.step5: Launch the modpack and start your space journey!

about.title: The Lone Panda
about.body1: Hey there! 👋 Welcome to AlahPanda Labs — a one-developer show powered by passion, an unhealthy amount of coffee, and a MacBook that's constantly questioning its life choices.
about.body2: This is not a platform. It's not a startup. It's a curated personal repository for my Minecraft modpacks — built with direct installation guides, optimized metadata, and zero corporate nonsense.
about.body3: Every modpack here was born from hours of testing, tweaking, and occasionally yelling at config files. I build what I want to play, and I share it because... well, why not?
about.body4: If something breaks, that's a feature. If something works perfectly, I'm as surprised as you are. 🐼
